title: Orders
description: Sales orders: the sample orders of the synthetic demo set and the orders entered here. Nothing is ordered from this list.

form.title: Sales order {{number}}
form.newDescription: Enter a customer's PO as a draft. Nothing is posted to Business Central from here.
form.draftDescription: A draft: entry is not finished and nothing is reserved. Edit it, submit it when the PO is fully entered, or void it. Stock figures are from the mock Business Central.

fields.customerHint: Search by Business Central number or name. The number is what is saved.
fields.externalDocumentNoHint: One customer and PO number is one order.

errors.customer: Choose the customer from the list.
errors.poLong: A PO number has {{max}} characters at most, and this one has {{length}}. Shorten it.
errors.shipmentDate: Enter a valid shipment date, or leave it empty.
errors.shipmentBeforeOrder: This is before the order date. Choose that day or a later one.
errors.prepayment: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100, with two decimals at most.
errors.item: Choose an item from the list.
errors.description: A description has 100 characters at most. Shorten it.
errors.unitPrice: Enter a unit price, for example 12.50.
errors.tooMany: An order has 200 lines at most. Remove some lines.

lines.hint: Availability is mock Business Central's figure, refreshed every 30 seconds. A draft reserves nothing.
lines.priceHint: The price comes from the customer's PO. The last agreed price under a price is for reference only.

notices.duplicateBody: This customer and PO number already have an order, {{orderNo}}. Open it to see it.
notices.duplicateReading: Checking whether {{orderNo}} can take a new PO version.
notices.duplicateDraft: {{orderNo}} is still a draft. Open it to edit it.
notices.duplicateSubmitted: {{orderNo}} is submitted: order date {{orderDate}}, {{count}} lines, PO version {{current}}. If this is the customer's revised PO, you can confirm it as PO version {{next}}. If it is a different PO that uses the same number, change the PO number here and save it as a new order.
notices.duplicateSubmittedRead: {{orderNo}} is submitted. A role that may edit orders can confirm a revised PO as its next PO version. Open the order to read it.
notices.duplicateVoid: {{orderNo}} was voided just now, so its PO number is free again. Save again to enter this order.
notices.duplicateUnknown: {{orderNo}} could not be read, so its state is not known. Open it to see it.
notices.staleBody: It was changed by someone else, or it is no longer a draft. Reload to see its current state before you save again.

readOnly.sample: A sample order of the synthetic demo set. Its details cannot be edited here.
readOnly.submitted: This order is submitted. Only a draft can be changed.
readOnly.void: This order is void. It cannot be changed.
readOnly.permission: Your role may read orders but not change them.

toast.createdNew: Order {{orderNo}} saved. Ready for the next one.

void.title: Void this draft?
void.description: A voided order cannot be changed, and its PO number is free to use again. Say why.

submit.label: Submit order
submit.title: Submit order {{orderNo}}?
submit.consequence: You cannot undo this. Once it is submitted, OrderPilot cannot cancel the order, and its PO number stays with it. A revised PO with the same number can be added as a new PO version.
submit.notDone: Submitting does not approve the order, reserve stock or post anything to Business Central.
submit.zeroTotal: The total is 0.00. Check the unit prices before you submit.
submit.shortMore_one: Stock is short on {{item}} by {{quantity}} and {{count}} more item.
submit.shortMore_other: Stock is short on {{item}} by {{quantity}} and {{count}} more items.
submit.reloadTitle: This submit did not go through
submit.unknownTitle: We could not confirm the result
submit.unknownBody: The order may have been submitted. Reload the order to see which.

revision.title: Add this PO as PO version {{next}} of {{orderNo}}
revision.facts: {{orderNo}} now: order date {{orderDate}}, {{count}} lines, PO version {{current}}.
revision.noStage: No team has a task for this order, so confirming tells nobody.
revision.intro: These are the differences from PO version {{current}}, the current one. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
revision.headerHint: This form starts with today's date and a prepayment of 100% unless you changed them. Check the order date, shipment date and prepayment before you confirm.
revision.keepHeader: Keep the order's dates and prepayment
revision.keptHeader: Now using the order's dates and prepayment.
revision.zeroTotal: The total of this PO is 0.00.
revision.notDone: Confirming does not approve the order, check or reserve stock, or post anything to Business Central.
revision.consequence: You cannot undo this. PO version {{next}} becomes the order's current PO, and PO version {{current}} stays readable as superseded. If you confirm the wrong one, add another PO version with the right content.
revision.identical: This PO has the same dates, quantities and prices as PO version {{current}}, so there is nothing to confirm. Descriptions are not compared.
revision.previewFailedTitle: The differences could not be worked out
revision.nothingSaved: Nothing was saved. Ask whoever handles this order, then try again.
revision.staleHint: Compare again to see the differences from PO version {{current}}.
revision.closedTitle: This order cannot take a new PO version now
revision.unknownTitle: We could not confirm the result
revision.unknownBody: PO version {{next}} may have been saved. Open the order to see which.

form.denied: Your role may read orders but not start them.
